scientific limitations/integrity: The result computes the full automorphism group of the single explicit smooth special syzygy hypersurface displayed in Section 5.4.2 of the cited preprint. It does not classify all special pencils or make a positive-characteristic claim. The proof uses the source's automorphism--stabilizer identification and an elementary exact computation of the stabilizer of the annihilator pencil; the included symbolic check verifies the tangent dimension independently.
title: The special Bunnett–Namanya syzygy hypersurface has automorphism group \(\operatorname{GL}_2\)
